subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Group guided: builds sight vocabulary (high-frequency words)

show.line: Some words we just know. The, and, said, you, was, they. Look at them and read them fast!

rounds.prompt: The dog and the cat. Which word is missing? The dog, gap, the cat.
rounds.praise: And! The dog and the cat.

rounds.prompt: Read the sentence. Mom said, come here. Which word is said?
Is it a word we know by sight, or a picture? Put each card in its group.

hints: Look at the shape of the whole word. Do not sound it out.
Think of the sentence. Which word makes sense?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That word is they. You is a shorter word.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. They. They went home!

parent_line: Can read common words like the, and, said, you, was and they by sight.
